decisions.reason: The package still requires the same PE-stamped letter deliverable; the corrected Nevada PE identity is independently maintained by the source Requirement and does not alter the package format or obligations.
Changing the Nevada PE name and license number does not alter the limited review scope covering the minor electrical modifications in the Word file.
The corrected PE identity does not change the required written scope, photographs, room identifiers, or location markups used to verify the modifications.
Message 46 supplies a Nevada PE license for the stamping project and does not provide or resolve the separately requested California electrical PE credential.
The PE identity correction does not change the electrical calculations required for the separate additional permit drawing project.
The source identifies the Nevada PE for the stamping project but does not change the permit-ready electrical drawing or stamping obligations of the separate additional permit project.
The corrected Nevada PE identity has no effect on the existing Manual J, Manual S, Manual D, HVAC sizing, or Title 24 calculation requirements.
